description: Ministry of Sport -  Order made to amend the Orter Published in Gaz.Ex.ord No. 1793/03 of 15.01.2013 by adding nex Sport - No. 60 Climbing and Monutaineering
categorisation: This gazette contains an order made by the Minister of Sports under Section 28 of the Sports Act, No. 25 of 1973, which amends a schedule to add a new sport/sport class. This constitutes a regulatory matter involving the modification of subsidiary legislation under an existing Act, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette.
